prompt:
Theme: White and Black in the Shade

Subject:
A full-body vertical fashion portrait of a woman in her 20s squatting deeply on a dirt path in a park with dappled sunlight. She occupies the center of the frame, with her head in the upper center, torso and arms in the middle, waist and bent knees in the lower middle, and black platform shoes at the bottom edge. Legs are spread slightly wider than shoulder-width with feet flat on the ground. She leans slightly forward, looking directly at the camera with her face tilted slightly to her left.

Character and Expression:
Small oval face, light ivory skin, big hazel brown eyes, and coral beige lips. She looks calmly into the lens with a slightly open mouth. Hair is bright ash brown reaching below the chest, styled with thin bangs and a high braided ponytail. Natural sunlight falls on her head, cheeks, and shoulders. Wearing pearl earrings and a silver necklace.

Pose and Clothing:
A cream-colored ribbed halter neck top with a deep V-neck and lace trim. The bottom is a white asymmetrical mini skirt with metal snaps, a belt, and a long white strap on the right. Wearing white ribbed loose socks and black leather lace-up platform shoes with very thick soles. Detailed fingers, pale nails, and realistic grounding of the shoes.

Background and Light:
A park path with pebbles and dry soil, showing fallen leaves and tree shadows. A thick tree trunk on the upper right and vibrant green foliage above. Soft natural light through leaves creates dappled spots on her hair, face, and clothing. Tight shadows are formed under the black shoes. Background is blurred with circular green bokeh.

Composition and Camera:
Vertical 2:3 frame, full-body portrait shot from a level slightly lower than chest height. Strong contrast between white clothing and black shoes. The person occupies about 80% of the screen height. Sharp focus on eyes, face, and clothing details. Background is smoothly blurred.

Texture and Style:
High-resolution realistic summer street fashion photography. Colors include cream, white, warm skin tones, black leather, and forest greens. Precise textures of skin, hair braids, fabric ribs, and leather shine. Balanced highlights and shadows.

Negatives:
Avoid facial distortion, extra fingers, merging of limbs, anatomically incorrect joints, gravity contradictions, and excessive skin smoothing.
